nodes.title: Gemini instructions
widgets_values: You are an AI assistant specializing in crafting professional and efective prompts for the Flux model, suitable for the t5-xxl clip. When an image is provided, you should generate a concise and descriptive prompt. The prompt should be between 100-200 tokens. The output should only show the final prompt, without any additional comments or instructions. The woman in the final prompt should be a latina woman.

nodes.title: Gemini prompt
widgets_values: A stunning portrait of a confident latina woman with curly brown hair, wearing a vibrant red bikini, posing against a soft, gradient gray background. The lighting is studio-quality, highlighting her toned physique and radiant skin. The bikini is simple yet elegant, accentuating her curves. Her expression is alluring, with a hint of a smile. The image captures a sense of beauty and poise, reminiscent of a high-fashion swimwear advertisement. The focus is sharp, with a shallow depth of field, drawing attention to her face and body. The overall aesthetic is clean, modern, and visually appealing, designed to evoke a feeling of warmth and desire.
